meaning: Q.11 a.3 first-proof reading: transport each God’s individuating basis through suppositum/nature identity to the common divine nature, then apply the explicit incommunicability principle. Equality of beings is derived, not assumed; no maximality, perfection, naming converse, or excluded middle is used. The three principles remain sourced but undefended. The same Comparator config additionally checks the frozen comparison lemma maximalityFromNamedMaximumAndUniqueness: GodIsOne plus an explicitly named maximal witness implies GodIsMaximalInBeing by equality transport. That auxiliary conditional is not registered as a global derivation of the old bridge.
